restoration.native_method: Three independent waveform-envelope windows; confirm actual words and speaking cadence. Preserve failed media; do not weaken gate.
restoration.trim_method: Measured median native offset rounded to 24-fps frame; only positive head trim while preserving audio duration + 0.1-second coverage.
restoration.actual_cost_basis: Measured provider native-trim duration at existing $8/min rate; root budget ledger controls submissions.
restoration.alignment_and_review: Measure restored audio insertion offset, quantize picture selection, run existing sync diagnostics, inspect normal-speed delivery and film seam. Audio identity is not proof of perceptual mouth sync.

retained_F02.observation: The initial held-key pose continues into the guest departure; retain the accepted later source crop.
